title: Effective EMF Value
description: Essential: The student's final answer for part (1) must be 50 V.

title: Transformer Turns Ratio
description: Essential: The student's final answer for part (2) must be 5:1 (or equivalent).

title: Maximum Number of Lamps
description: Essential: The student's final answer for part (3) must be 7.

title: Peak EMF Calculation
description: Important: The solution must correctly calculate the peak EMF using the formula nBSω.

title: RMS Conversion
description: Important: The solution must correctly convert the peak EMF to its effective (RMS) value by dividing by √2.

title: Transformer Voltage Ratio
description: Important: The solution must apply the transformer voltage ratio U1/U2 = n1/n2 correctly.

title: Power Conservation
description: Important: The solution must apply power conservation (P1 = P2) for the ideal transformer to find the maximum output power.

title: Fuse Current Limit
description: Important: The solution must use the fusing current's effective value (1.5 A) to calculate the maximum input power P1m.

title: Lamp Power Calculation
description: Optional: The solution may explicitly note the lamp's rated power (10 W) is used to find the number of lamps.

title: Confusing Peak and RMS
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student uses the peak EMF (50√2 V) as the primary voltage or confuses peak and RMS values in power calculations.

title: Ignoring Fuse Limit
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student calculates the number of lamps using the bulb's normal operating current instead of the maximum current set by the fuse.
